messages:
Alex: Heads-up — planning to cut the release branch at 19:00 UTC today. Need a quick sync on docsite staging deploy + SDK docs regen. Who can own the deploy window?
Sara: I can own the staging deploy. I'll be available from 18:30 UTC to prep. @Mike please freeze non-critical doc PRs (or tag them). :thumbsup:
Mike: freezing now. Will only merge PRs with label `release-critical`. Shout PR numbers here if you need an emergency patch.
Jin: I can run SDK regen after the cut. One ask: bump the SDK toolchain image to node:20 so the regen pipeline doesn't fail. @Irma can you confirm the API diff is stable for regen?
Irma: on it — running a quick diff v1.3.2 -> v1.4.0 now. Will flag any breaking doc redirects or schema changes in ~15m.
Alex: Proposed timeline: cut @ 19:00, deploy docsite to staging @ 19:15, run SDK docs regen @ 19:30, smoke tests + promo ~19:50. If anything slips we hold promo.
Sara: OK. I'll schedule staging deploy at 19:15 and include a 10m hold for smoke tests. Rollback plan: revert to last-stable tag and redeploy.
Mike: Add this mini checklist for emergency merges: `tag`, `changelog entry`, `tests pass (basic)`, `2 approvals` — post PR link here.
Jin: SDK regen commands (I'll run after cut):
```
# regen SDK docs for python and js
./scripts/sdk-regenerate --targets=py,js --tag=release-2026-03-17
make docs-deploy ENV=staging TAG=release-2026-03-17
```
Jin: note — regen pipeline currently uses image `redwood/sdk-builder:2026-03-01`. If we need node20 I can push `2026-03-17-node20` before the cut.
docs-ci: build queued for `docs-staging` (ID: 84217) — will post status updates here.
Irma: found two redirect issues in the API section, filing a single PR now (will be `release-critical` if it touches examples).
deploy-bot: staging deploy started for tag `release-2026-03-17` by Sara at 19:15 UTC. Monitor: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/84217
Alex: perfect — thanks everyone. If we hit any unexpected regressions, call it and we'll delay promo. I'll update the release checklist with owners.
